balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public; moves tokens from msg.sender
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public; sets allowance

allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant; reads allowed mapping

safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure; c = a + b with require(c >= a)
safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure; require(b <= a); c = a - b
safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure; c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure; require(b > 0); c = a / b
msg.sender; externally controlled caller address used for auth and balance bookkeeping
